defects.label: fix
defects.summary: Internal inconsistency: lifecycle ordering runs render before finalize, but finalize writes search index assets that the rendered search page/runtime must reference; this needs an explicit deterministic-path contract (or hook ordering change).

evidence.note: Hook ordering explicitly places finalize after render.
evidence.quote: Fixed ordering: init → collectFiles → transform → resolve → render → finalize.

evidence.note: High-level dataflow says renderer renders search page, then search index plugin writes artifacts in finalize.

patch.value: CLI invocation → Core Orchestrator (C8) loads config and registers plugins → init hook → File Collector Plugin (C9) populates noteRegistry in shared context via collectFiles hook → Markdown Parser Plugin (C10) enriches each note with AST, frontmatter, and raw links via transform hook → Backlink Resolver Plugin (C11) builds forward/backlink graphs and attaches backlink metadata via resolve hook → Tag Aggregator Plugin (C12) builds tag index and registers tag pages via resolve hook → Theme/Renderer Plugin (C14) renders note pages, tag pages, index, and search page to output directory via render hook, using a deterministic agreed search-index asset path (e.g., /assets/search-index.json) → Search Index Plugin (C13) builds and writes client-side search index artifacts to that deterministic path via finalize hook → Client-Side Runtime (C15) loads the search index from that path and provides interactive search/tag/backlink UI in the browser.

evidence.quote: Markdown Parser Plugin (C10) that parses Markdown to AST, extracts frontmatter, and normalizes internal link references.

evidence.quote: M1 core design will use abstract link/tag models that are syntax-agnostic; concrete parsing is deferred to M2 plugins.

patch.value: Markdown Parser Plugin (C10) that parses Markdown to AST, extracts frontmatter, and extracts internal link *candidates* into an abstract/syntax-agnostic model (full normalization rules finalized in M2 after Q1).
